lastCompletedStory.title: WARNING: listSourceFiles usa entry.isFile(), que e false para symlink, entao ar…

nextStoryContext: COSS verification now rejects every symbolic-link entry before the isDirectory/isFile branches. This deliberately fail-closed policy avoids silently skipped linked source as well as directory cycles, root escapes, and link-path-relative resolution ambiguity; the CLI regression test uses an external target containing a forbidden @coss/ui import and proves nonzero exit.

officialDocsValidated.summary: The change uses only the existing Node.js-compatible filesystem Dirent API and touches no external library.
